(B) EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION
Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering/Technology with I't Class or equivalent from a
recognized University OR if the candidate has a Master's Degree Engineering/Technology,

Not exceeding 35 years of age as on 20.07,2024. However, the upper age limit is relaxable in

(D) METHOD OF SELECTTON

Recruitment Test, if conducted, shall be objective/subjective examination in concemed
subject. The syllabus and scheme for the examination will be made available on the
Commissions website in due course of time.
Incase Recruitment Test is conducted, the written examination will be held tentatively in the
4th week of |vly,2024.
